figurative_meaning_en: To beat or do something to one's heart's content or personal satisfaction
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ছেলেকে হাতের সুখ করে পেটালো।
বন্ধুরা মাঠে হাতের সুখ করে খেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: He beat his son to his heart's content.
The friends played to their satisfaction in the field.
note: Often used in contexts implying unrestrained action for personal pleasure, typically negative.
